finalMessage: # Independent Review - Round 3x (Layout & Print Hardening) (1) Value Splitting & Nowrap Overflow: - Dates (`.date-cell`), BP, weight, and GA use `nowrap` and will not split mid-word, mid-number, or mid-date. - [Should-fix] [PatientPrintHtmlGenerator.kt:865](file:///Users/sherifgamalradwan/anc-emr-android-native/app/src/main/java/com/sherifradwan/ancnative/ui/report/PatientPrintHtmlGenerator.kt#L865): `.clinical-table td.text-navy { white-space: nowrap; }` Applies `nowrap` to all `td.text-navy`. Aimed at BP (L114) and EFW (L166), but collateral damage hits Lab Test Name (L193: `${escapeHtml(l.testName)}`) and Medication Name (L216: `${escapeHtml(m.name)}`). Long test names ("High Vaginal Swab Culture & Sensitivity") and drug names ("Calcium Carbonate + Vitamin D3") cannot wrap and will overflow fixed column bounds at A4 width and in 380px preview. Fix: remove L865 and add `nowrap-cell` explicitly to the BP and EFW cells. - Dosage uses normal breaking and does not split mid-word/number, wrapping safely across spaces. (2) List Truncation & Counts (Q117): - All 4 truncated lists (visits cap 12 col 6, scans cap 7 col 7, labs cap 10 col 4, meds cap 8 col 5) correctly invoke `hiddenRowsHtml` with the exact count and matching colspan. - Thresholds are exact: at cap (diff 0) and under cap emit no row; empty state displays existing notice; one over emits "and 1 more not shown". - No silent `.take(` or truncations remain; previous pregnancies and appendix photos render completely. (3) HTML Escaping: - All patient and clinical fields in the touched rows remain escaped via `escapeHtml()`. (4) Signature Box (Q116): - "Official Stamp & Signature" appears exactly once (inside `.stamp-placeholder`). Doctor name and official title are intact. (5) CSS & Scope: - [Nit] [PatientPrintHtmlGenerator.kt:1120-1126](file:///Users/sherifgamalradwan/anc-emr-android-native/app/src/main/java/com/sherifradwan/ancnative/ui/report/PatientPrintHtmlGenerator.kt#L1120-L1126): Ultrasound col widths were rebalanced (GA 12%->14%, Placenta 14%->12%, EFW 14%->12%, Notes 21%->24%). Safe (keeps header from breaking), but unrequested by Q115. - No dead CSS or unapproved wording modifications found. (6) Test Verification & Fidelity: - Tests directly exercise `PatientPrintHtmlGenerator.generateHtml` (production code) and would fail on pre-R3x code. - [Nit] [PrintLayoutTest.kt:32,45,51](file:///Users/sherifgamalradwan/anc-emr-android-native/app/src/test/java/com/sherifradwan/ancnative/ui/report/PrintLayoutTest.kt#L32): Builders use short stub names ("Drug0", "Test 0"), masking the `td.text-navy` nowrap overflow bug. - Verification status: `python3 .agents/checks/check_r3x.py` ran and PASSED (S97, S98). Unit tests (`PrintLayoutTest`, `PrintSampleDumpTest`) not run (local Gradle daemon socket connection blocked by sandbox).
